why: The issue's 'retain applicable shortcuts with brief status feedback'. The always-visible topbar label was the only thing that told a player whether the game was muted or merely silent -- no music ships, so silence is the normal condition either way -- and removing it without a replacement makes a mis-typed M indistinguishable from a broken build. The mute still happens, which is why nothing but the toast can see this.
